summary: The exact candidate fixes the reproduced no-rope DCP default reserved-slot corruption and owner/localization contract, retains the index-K virtual-capacity and DCP capacity-bound corrections, and passes focused candidate and independent gfx950 GPU cases. Full GLM-5.3-Flash 8xH100 long-context serving behavior remains unverified in the available environment.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before on the recorded base: DCP size 2/rank 0, no-rope loc 0, NaN source, and the public default reserved_skip_index=0 overwrote physical slot 0.
Eight independent GPU cases passed across DCP ranks 0/1, rope/no-rope, default reserved skipping, explicit skip disabling, owner filtering, and loc//world_size translation.
Candidate regression: 6 passed, including public-default reserved-slot parity for rope and no-rope.
Full focused module: 11 passed and 58 CUDA TMA-only tests skipped on ROCm.
Three boundary tests passed for target index-K virtual sizing, draft no-double-scaling, and non-DCP behavior.

gpu_execution.evidence: The changed Triton no-rope scatter compiled and executed on one AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, using torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and Triton 3.7.0.

remaining_limitations: No GLM-5.3-Flash model weights were available.
Only one AMD gfx950 GPU was assigned, not the reported 8xH100 DCP topology.
The cumulative-allocation watermark and semantic-quality serving reproduction was not run.
Sparse decode/verify collective reconstruction and sparse-extend prefix gathering were not qualified end to end.
CUDA TMA-only tests cannot execute on ROCm.
No native C++ or FlyDSL source changed, so a separate native rebuild was not applicable.
